artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan adding a pick/bind mode and link-route registration to sapience-project-bind.sh, with the script as sole writer of .sapience/project.json on both the vendor-delegated and HTTP-fallback paths, plus the /sapience picker surface and the domain link-route record.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan phase edits a file under agent-system/extensions/** and its test suite uses common_test_resolve_subject with mode "deploy-tree-first", the in-phase verification MUST export CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store or it silently runs the STALE deployed .claude/ copy instead of the edited source. common_test_resolve_subject emits only a stderr WARNING in that case and still returns the deployed path, never a non-zero exit -- so a phase whose verification criteria just name the suite will pass green against unedited code. The alternative (running deploy-headless.sh inside the phase) is a whole-tree claim that serializes against every concurrent sibling, so the env override is the right choice for a per-phase check and the redeploy belongs at the orchestration close.
